summary: Vivmark Residential (formerly Equity Residential) filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its merger with AvalonBay Communities, completed August 17, 2026, per an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated May 20, 2026. AvalonBay contributed assets in exchange for OP units in ERP Operating LP, then merged into Canopy Merger Sub LLC, a Vivmark subsidiary, with Merger Sub surviving. No per-share price or premium was disclosed. The transaction constitutes an acquisition, with Vivmark as the target. Watch for integration details and any post-closing OP unit conversions.
